# Brat Generator

> Brat Generator is a free browser-based suite of Brat-inspired creative tools for text, memes, images, typography, album-cover-style artwork and animated video.

Canonical site: https://bratgeneratorpro.net/

Important notes:
- Brat Generator is an independent fan-made project and is not affiliated with Charli XCX, Atlantic Records, or Warner Music.
- The main Brat text generator lives on the homepage.
- The image-based tools process the active design in the browser; uploaded background images are used locally by the current editor workflow.
- The default Brat Green preset uses #8ACE00 as a practical digital approximation; display appearance can vary.
- For legal or commercial-use questions, see the Terms & Disclaimer page.

## Tools

- [Brat Generator / Text Tool](https://bratgeneratorpro.net/#generator): Main Brat text generator with colour, blur, spacing, canvas and PNG/JPG/WebP export controls.
- [Brat Video Generator](https://bratgeneratorpro.net/video-generator/): Animated Brat-style text workflow with optional audio, FPS controls and video/GIF/frame exports.
- [Brat Meme Generator](https://bratgeneratorpro.net/brat-meme-generator/): Meme workspace with top/bottom text, photo upload, colour controls, blur, lo-fi effects and image export.
- [Brat Image Generator](https://bratgeneratorpro.net/brat-image-generator/): Image creator with custom text, background upload, colour presets, effects and multiple canvas ratios.
- [Brat Album Cover Generator](https://bratgeneratorpro.net/brat-album-cover-generator/): Square cover-art creator with title, artist line, colours, blur, optional background image and high-resolution export.

Each dedicated tool page includes its own short how-to-use section, feature summary, use cases, tips and related internal links.
